labels.Lỗi biên dịch: A real syntax or type error stops compilation (missing semicolon or brace, undeclared variable, wrong return statement, misspelled keyword). Trust compile_log: if it says the file compiled, the answer is No.
labels.Lỗi nhập/xuất: Input is read wrongly or output is not in the required format: wrong words or case (TRUE instead of True), missing or extra values, wrong separators or spacing, wrong file reading. An input prompt such as "Input n: " before the answer is NOT an error for this teacher. A wrong computed value alone is not this error.
labels.Lỗi logic: A wrong condition, formula, comparison or branch inside an otherwise reasonable approach, so some results are wrong.
labels.Lỗi vòng lặp: A loop bound, start, update or stop condition is wrong: off-by-one, a skipped or repeated element, or a loop variable never updated (infinite loop, often a timeout on small tests).
labels.Lỗi mảng/chuỗi: Wrong index, out-of-bounds access, wrong string or array handling (wrong substring, wrong character access, wrong concatenation), or returning a pointer to a local array.
labels.Lỗi hàm: Wrong function definition or use: wrong parameters or return type, missing return value, wrong call, a required function missing or with a changed prototype (the test driver cannot build it), or library functions misused.
labels.Lỗi edge case: The main cases work but boundary inputs fail: smallest or largest values, empty input, a single element, all values equal, negative numbers, or a special case the statement mentions. Typical evidence: normal tests pass while edge-category tests fail.
labels.Lỗi thuật toán: The core method or formula for the main computation is wrong (for example a wrong formula for an age, a power or a sum), the approach cannot solve the stated problem, or it is far too slow for the constraints (timeouts only on large tests).
labels.Lỗi hard-code: Fixed values that should come from the input or the data: a fixed file name or path, a fixed array size, record count or loop count, special-casing particular test values, or printing an expected answer instead of computing it.
labels.Lỗi style: Poor code style without necessarily a functional error: most or all of the solution commented out, a function needlessly long or convoluted for what it does, heavy copy-paste, or names that hide the meaning.
